title: Vercel provider slice: fourteen-category investigation with official evidence and offline fixtures
objective: Investigate Vercel across all fourteen canonical service categories using current OFFICIAL vercel.com plans, pricing, limits, storage, and changelog evidence, then land a provider-scoped declarative profile module, complete coverage YAML, deterministic offline fixtures, unit and real-PostgreSQL integration tests, and the Vercel section of docs/PROVIDER_ADAPTERS.md.
in_scope: .secrets.baseline only if fixture sha256_stored values are detected
acceptance_criteria: A1: the offline runner against real PostgreSQL persists scan_run, snapshot, candidate, official evidence, and only gate-allowed offer/version/quota rows for Vercel.
A2: every published Z0 verdict is evidence-backed and explainable; the 14-day Pro trial proves a no-card time limit is Z2, and unknown material facts remain withheld.
A3: coverage contains every canonical category exactly once; every verified_free/offered_no_z0 entry cites official Vercel evidence and every not_offered entry has a rationale.
A4: Q9-A is met by at least three official-backed categories; Hobby hosting, Functions, and CDN are not hidden as unknown.
A5: every service-category assignment has a YAML rationale; Vercel Functions and Edge Network arguable mappings are disclosed in the draft PR.
A6: unchanged, changed, partial, malformed, contradictory, withdrawn, and stale are exercised; material cases assert persisted rows.
A7: the Vercel Storage capture distinguishes native Blob/Global Config from third-party Marketplace Postgres/KV/NoSQL integrations; no partner allowance is represented as Vercel-native.
A8: Alembic remains 0011, no dependency or shared semantic changes occur, tests are offline, NodeAudit exits zero, and the full real-DB suite has exactly the two existing stack-health skips.
A9: isolated-stack contamination control affects only this slice's API-dependent checks and cleanup leaves no slice resources or port listeners.
A10: one pre-declared mutation probes an untested extraction axis and its actual result is reported.
verification_plan: pytest full suite with DATABASE_URL and exactly two stack-health skips
isolated smoke before/during/after stopping only fta-p2-vercel API

isolation.note: Local .env is uncommitted. Cleanup targets only this compose project and exact-tag images.

risks: Vercel historical Postgres/KV packaging is stale. Current storage docs identify Marketplace providers such as Neon and Upstash; those are not Vercel-native free services.
Hobby is restricted to personal, non-commercial use. This condition must remain in captured evidence and documentation rather than being simplified to an unrestricted free plan.
Out-of-vocabulary offer_type values can fail open before persistence. Every profile therefore requires canonical evidence-backed offer_type and malformed/partial cases prove withholding.
The source page says Hobby has no billing cycle and pauses at exhaustion; any surface without equally clear safe-stop evidence stays unknown or non-Z0.
